name: Science and Technology
subject: Science and Technology
description: Here you will find the expectations and learning for the five areas of study for Grade 4.

strands.title: STEM Skills and Connections
strands.describer: Throughout Grade 4, in connection with the learning in the Life Systems, Matter and Energy, Structures and Mechanisms, and Earth and Space Systems strands, students will:

overall_expectations.title: STEM Investigation and Communication Skills
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 4, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
overall_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems
specific_expectations.text_html: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems

specific_expectations.text: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials
specific_expectations.text_html: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

specific_expectations.text: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes

overall_expectations.title: Coding and Emerging Technologies
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 4, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields
overall_expectations.text_html: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

specific_expectations.text: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on producing different types of output for a variety of purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on producing different types of output for a variety of purposes

specific_expectations.text: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life, including skilled trades
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life, including skilled trades

overall_expectations.title: Applications, Connections, and Contributions
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 4, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities

strands.title: Life Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess impacts of human activities on habitats and communities, and analyse actions for minimizing negative impacts and enhancing positive ones
overall_expectations.text_html: assess impacts of human activities on habitats and communities, and analyse actions for minimizing negative impacts and enhancing positive ones

specific_expectations.text: assess positive and negative impacts of human activities on habitats and communities, while taking different perspectives into account
specific_expectations.text_html: assess positive and negative impacts of human activities on habitats and communities, while taking different perspectives into account

specific_expectations.text: analyse the impact of the depletion or extinction of a species on its habitat and community, and describe possible actions to prevent such depletions or extinctions
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse the impact of the depletion or extinction of a species on its habitat and community, and describe possible actions to prevent such depletions or extinctions

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of habitats and communities and of interrelationships among the organisms that live in them
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of habitats and communities and of interrelationships among the organisms that live in them

specific_expectations.text: describe habitats as areas that provide organisms, including plants and animals, with the necessities of life, and identify ways in which a local habitat provides these necessities
specific_expectations.text_html: describe habitats as areas that provide organisms, including plants and animals, with the necessities of life, and identify ways in which a local habitat provides these necessities

specific_expectations.text: describe a community as a group of interacting species sharing a common habitat, and identify factors that affect the ability of a community of plants and animals to survive in a local habitat
specific_expectations.text_html: describe a community as a group of interacting species sharing a common habitat, and identify factors that affect the ability of a community of plants and animals to survive in a local habitat

specific_expectations.text: describe the relationship of organisms in a food chain, and classify organisms as producers, consumers, or decomposers
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the relationship of organisms in a food chain, and classify organisms as producers, consumers, or decomposers

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of a food web as the interconnection of multiple food chains in a natural community
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of a food web as the interconnection of multiple food chains in a natural community

specific_expectations.text: describe how animals are categorized according to their diet, and categorize various animals as carnivores, herbivores, or omnivores
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how animals are categorized according to their diet, and categorize various animals as carnivores, herbivores, or omnivores

specific_expectations.text: describe structural adaptations of a variety of plants and animals and how these adaptations allow the organisms to survive in specific habitats
specific_expectations.text_html: describe structural adaptations of a variety of plants and animals and how these adaptations allow the organisms to survive in specific habitats

specific_expectations.text: explain why all habitats have limits to the number of plants and animals they can support
specific_expectations.text_html: explain why all habitats have limits to the number of plants and animals they can support

strands.title: Matter and Energy
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the impacts on society and the environment of technological innovations related to light and sound
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the impacts on society and the environment of technological innovations related to light and sound

specific_expectations.text: assess the impacts on society of devices that use the properties of light or sound, or both
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impacts on society of devices that use the properties of light or sound, or both

specific_expectations.text: assess the impacts on the environment of light energy and sound energy produced by various technologies, while taking different perspectives into account
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impacts on the environment of light energy and sound energy produced by various technologies, while taking different perspectives into account

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of light and sound as forms of energy that have specific characteristics and properties
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of light and sound as forms of energy that have specific characteristics and properties

specific_expectations.text: identify a variety of natural and artificial light sources
specific_expectations.text_html: identify a variety of natural and artificial light sources

specific_expectations.text: distinguish between objects and living things that emit their own light and those that reflect light from other sources
specific_expectations.text_html: distinguish between objects and living things that emit their own light and those that reflect light from other sources

specific_expectations.text: describe properties of light, including that light travels in a straight path and that light can be absorbed, reflected, and refracted
specific_expectations.text_html: describe properties of light, including that light travels in a straight path and that light can be absorbed, reflected, and refracted

specific_expectations.text: describe properties of sound, including that sound travels through a medium as a wave and that sound can be absorbed or reflected and modified
specific_expectations.text_html: describe properties of sound, including that sound travels through a medium as a wave and that sound can be absorbed or reflected and modified

specific_expectations.text: explain how vibrations cause sound waves
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how vibrations cause sound waves

specific_expectations.text: describe how different objects and materials interact with light and sound energy
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how different objects and materials interact with light and sound energy

specific_expectations.text: distinguish between sources of light that emit both light and heat and those that emit light but little heat
specific_expectations.text_html: distinguish between sources of light that emit both light and heat and those that emit light but little heat

specific_expectations.text: identify sensory organs and devices that make use of the properties of light and sound
specific_expectations.text_html: identify sensory organs and devices that make use of the properties of light and sound

strands.title: Structures and Mechanisms
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:
overall_expectations.text: evaluate the impacts of various machines and their mechanisms on society and the environment
overall_expectations.text_html: evaluate the impacts of various machines and their mechanisms on society and the environment

specific_expectations.text: assess the impacts of machines and their mechanisms on the daily lives of people in various communities
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impacts of machines and their mechanisms on the daily lives of people in various communities

specific_expectations.text: assess and compare the environmental impacts of using different machines designed for similar purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: assess and compare the environmental impacts of using different machines designed for similar purposes

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the basic principles and functions of machines and their mechanisms
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the basic principles and functions of machines and their mechanisms

specific_expectations.text: identify machines that are used in daily life, and describe their purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: identify machines that are used in daily life, and describe their purposes

specific_expectations.text: identify the parts of various mechanisms and describe the purpose of each part
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the parts of various mechanisms and describe the purpose of each part

specific_expectations.text: describe how different mechanisms transmit various types of motion, including rotary motion, from one system to another
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how different mechanisms transmit various types of motion, including rotary motion, from one system to another

specific_expectations.text: describe how mechanisms transform motion, including how they can change the geometric plane in which the motion occurs and the speed and/or direction of motion
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how mechanisms transform motion, including how they can change the geometric plane in which the motion occurs and the speed and/or direction of motion

specific_expectations.text: explain how forces are changed in a variety of machines
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how forces are changed in a variety of machines

strands.title: Earth and Space Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the social and environmental impacts of geological processes and of human uses of rocks and minerals
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the social and environmental impacts of geological processes and of human uses of rocks and minerals

specific_expectations.text: analyse ways in which geological processes impact society and the environment
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse ways in which geological processes impact society and the environment

specific_expectations.text: assess social and environmental impacts of extracting and refining rocks and minerals and of manufacturing, recycling, and disposing of products derived from rocks and minerals, while taking various perspectives into account
specific_expectations.text_html: assess social and environmental impacts of extracting and refining rocks and minerals and of manufacturing, recycling, and disposing of products derived from rocks and minerals, while taking various perspectives into account

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 4, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of rocks, minerals, and Earth’s geological processes
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of rocks, minerals, and Earth’s geological processes

specific_expectations.text: explain geological processes that result in the formation of igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks, using the rock cycle
specific_expectations.text_html: explain geological processes that result in the formation of igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks, using the rock cycle

specific_expectations.text: describe the physical properties of igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the physical properties of igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks

specific_expectations.text: classify different rocks and minerals according to their composition and physical properties, using various tests and criteria
specific_expectations.text_html: classify different rocks and minerals according to their composition and physical properties, using various tests and criteria

specific_expectations.text: describe everyday uses of rocks and minerals
specific_expectations.text_html: describe everyday uses of rocks and minerals

specific_expectations.text: describe how fossils are formed and what information they can provide about Earth’s history
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how fossils are formed and what information they can provide about Earth’s history

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit geological knowledges that are used in the selection of different rocks and minerals for specific purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit geological knowledges that are used in the selection of different rocks and minerals for specific purposes
